ios.desc:
The Content Creator’s Compass for Golden Hour Mastery
Stop guessing where the sun will set. Golden Hour Sunset Compass is the only sun tracker and mapping tool built for the demanding workflow of Instagram photographers, travel vloggers, drone pilots, & TikTok creators. Fusing real-time solar analytics with a stunning, Apple Glass-inspired interface, Golden Hour Sunset Compass delivers the exact light data you need to guarantee a cinematic result-every single time.

The Problem: Other sun apps are cluttered and built for astronomers. The Sunpath Solution: A clean, powerful tool engineered for speed, on-camera credibility, and golden hour precision.

Unmatched Precision for Filmmakers and Photographers
Golden Hour Sunset Compass is designed to put the sun exactly where you want it. This hybrid compass-map tool eliminates precious setup time lost to guessing, allowing you to focus on framing the perfect shot seconds before the light changes.

Real-Time Solar Compass: Lock the Sunset Line
Live Azimuth Guide: A precise pointer fuses magnetometer data with solar vectors, eliminating the common "spin and guess" problem in basic sun locator apps.

Golden Hour Countdown: Pinpoint blue hour, civil twilight, and the exact golden window with up-to-the-second timers and visual progress rings.

Zero Clutter UI: The futuristic, glassmorphic interface is engineered for on-camera credibility, giving your device a premium look when featured in a vlog.

Immersive Sun Map: Scout Angles Before You Arrive
Cinematic Map Overlay: Drop a pin on any rooftop, beach, or overlook and see the sun's exact arc over the landscape.

Pin Management System: Save unlimited shooting spots with notes, titles, and coordinates. Share location cards instantly with your crew for seamless filmmaking collaboration.

Scouting Power: Visually confirm your camera angle and orientation on the map, ensuring the sun is always framed perfectly relative to your saved spot.

Creator Workflow Ready
Save and manage location cards for shoots, with quick actions to navigate back.

Keep a running log of favorite content spots using elegant glass cards.

Designed specifically for Instagram Photographers, travel vloggers, TikTok creators, drone pilots, elopement filmmakers, and influencers chasing that viral sunset reel.

Ad-supported model keeps this essential tool free for the next generation of creators.

Beyond the Camera: Other Power Users
While the Golden Hour Sunset Compass is engineered for content creators
